errors.error_description: Implemented the 8:1 multiplexer as a deeply nested if-else chain, creating long combinational paths instead of using a balanced case or one-hot mux structure.
Used an incomplete sensitivity list in a combinational always block (listed only sel, in0, in1) while reading in2–in7 inside the block.
Instantiated a child 2:1 mux with 8-bit ports but connected 16-bit signals to its a and b ports, creating a port width mismatch at the instance boundary.
